meta.name: Pewter Quill Router Head
meta.description: A brass and pewter pneumatic bellows cast by The Perpetual Clockwork Deep-Bore Syndicate. The Gravel Keeper often trades these relics to miners exploring the Brass Ledger Frontier. When socketed into a tool, its wind-up automation forcefully routes mined Pewter Gravel and other loose ores directly into a paired chest, though the delicate mechanism worsens the penalty for striking the wrong strata.
